artworks.title: Storm behind the Acropolis
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with an elevated viewpoint, showcasing the Acropolis and the Parthenon on a rocky hill. In the background, there are distant hills and a sky with detailed, swirling clouds. The color palette is mainly monochromatic, focusing on textures and structures in varying shades of black and white. The terrain is rugged, sloping towards the central hill with ruins scattered along the path leading to the Acropolis.

artworks.title: Building a Power House
artworks.description: The image shows an elevated view of a construction site next to a river. In the distance are notable natural and urban features, including a city skyline and a waterfall. The composition has a high horizon line, and the artist uses loose, expressive lines to convey energy. The color palette is monochromatic, in shades of black and gray, creating contrast. The construction area is detailed with scaffolding and work elements, the river flows toward the waterfall, and the background shows a skyline blending into the horizon under a cloudy sky.

artworks.title: The Travellers, Charleroi
artworks.description: The image shows an industrial scene with many buildings, chimneys, machinery, and smoke filling the sky. There are various smokestacks emitting smoke. The brushstrokes are detailed, depicting textures through lines and shading. The color palette is monochromatic in black, white, and gray. People and a railway line are visible, illustrating the scale of the scene, with large factory structures and machinery in the distance.

artworks.title: The Acropolis from the Temple of Jupiter, Athens
artworks.description: The image depicts a series of ancient columns towering upwards on the right. The horizon is low in the composition, marked by the base of the columns and distant ruins on a hill. The ruins rest in the middle distance, adding depth to the scene. The brushstrokes are sketch-like and illustrative, with detailed crosshatching providing texture to the sky and structures. The color palette is monochromatic, dominated by shades of gray and black, creating a timeless quality. The strong vertical lines of the columns contrast with the organic shapes of the clouds.

artworks.title: Sunrise over the Acropolis
artworks.description: The image shows a cityscape with an ancient architectural structure on top of a rocky hill, likely the Acropolis of Athens with the Parthenon visible. The viewpoint is elevated, overlooking a dense array of buildings extending into the distance. The hill dominates the composition, obscuring the horizon. The drawing is done in a monochromatic style using pencil strokes to create texture for the rocky hill and architectural details. The color palette is gray, giving a somber tone. The sky is suggested with light hatching, contrasting with the intricate structures and hill below, creating a sense of vastness.

artworks.title: The Erechtheum
artworks.description: The image depicts an ancient ruin, a classical building surrounded by scattered ruins and pillars. There are faint outlines of more ruins or landscape features in the middle distance. The drawing style uses a mix of fine and bold pencil strokes for texture on the stone surfaces and environment. The color palette is monochromatic, with various shades of gray for depth and detail. The sky in the distance is rendered in soft, blurry strokes contrasted with the sharper lines of the architecture and rubble in the foreground.

artworks.title: The Way up to the Acropolis
artworks.description: The image shows ancient ruins with towering classical columns in the background. The columns dominate the upper part of the composition, indicating an acropolis or temple structure. The horizon is not distinct, and the columns extend into the sky where clouds are dispersed. The brushstrokes are loose and sketch-like, capturing the architecture and rocky landscape with rough lines. The color palette is monochrome, focusing on black, white, and grey for contrast and texture. Stone steps lead upwards in the foreground, with remaining walls and columns suggesting a complex history. Soft clouds contrast with the detailed structures in the background.

artworks.title: The Lake of Fire, Charleroi
artworks.description: The image presents an industrial landscape dominated by large factory buildings and tall smokestacks. The horizon is high in the composition, with the factories and smokestacks outlined against the night sky. Smoke belches out, blending into the atmosphere. The brushstrokes are bold and textured, conveying movement and energy, particularly in the swirling smoke. The color palette is monochromatic, using shades of black and grey. Two small figures are visible on a slope leading to a body of water, reflecting the glow and shadows of the distant factories.

artworks.title: The Propylaea, Athens
artworks.description: The image shows ancient ruins of grand architectural structures as seen from a slightly elevated point of view. The composition features tall, classical columns, partially standing walls, and stone rubble. The sketch-like pencil drawing focuses on light and shadow, using a monochromatic color palette of grays. The scene conveys a timeless and somber atmosphere, with subtle lines suggesting further architectural elements in the distance.

artworks.title: The Portico of the Parthenon
artworks.description: The image features a view of a grand architectural space with towering columns on either side, creating a perspective that leads towards an opening revealing a distant landscape with mountains or hills. The artwork shows detailed textures created with pencil or charcoal, contrasting dense shadows with lighter areas, particularly on the columns. A monochromatic color palette dominated by shades of gray accentuates the interplay of light and shadows, adding depth to the scene. The viewer's focus is drawn from the foreground through the columns to the bright opening showcasing the landscape.

artworks.title: The Dump, Charleroi
artworks.description: The image shows an elevated perspective looking towards a pyramid-shaped form in the distance on the right side, which appears to be an industrial slag heap. On the left are structures resembling industrial buildings and tall chimneys emitting smoke. The brushstrokes are loose and dynamic, with a monochromatic color palette of grey and black. Close to the foreground, there are a few human figures and a canal or pathway curving along the mound.

artworks.title: Changing Shifts, Charleroi
artworks.description: The image shows an industrial scene with tall smokestacks releasing smoke into the sky. The smokestacks are arranged in a way that leads the eye across the image, suggesting the vastness of the industrial complex. The horizon line is towards the middle of the composition, with industrial structures in the background. The style features expressive brushstrokes or drawing techniques, like cross-hatching and bold lines, creating a textured and gritty feel. The color palette is primarily black and white, emphasizing contrast and creating a dramatic impact. In the foreground, there are small buildings and silhouetted figures, providing scale to the towering structures.

artworks.title: Battle of the Nudes
artworks.description: This is an illustration of a scene showing multiple figures in combat surrounded by dense foliage. The figures are engaged in battle, wielding various weapons, and are depicted with detailed muscular anatomy and flowing hair. The background features stylized vegetation, creating a forest setting. Bold lines and cross-hatching are used to create depth and shadow. The composition conveys a sense of controlled chaos, emphasizing the intensity and movement of the battle.

artworks.title: The Round Tower
artworks.medium: etching, engraving, sulphur tint or open bite, burnishing [date should be read as "published 1780s"]
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an intricate, labyrinthine architectural space full of stairs and arches. The drawing depicts a complex environment of interwoven staircases, grand arches, and a multitude of architectural elements. The composition is dominated by dark lines and shaded areas. The play of light and shadow enhances the atmosphere of this architectural fantasy. The space is enclosed yet feels expansive with many different levels and angles at play. The style is reminiscent of etchings capturing detailed and textured imagined interiors.

artworks.title: The Grand Piazza
artworks.medium: etching, engraving, sulphur tint or open bite, burnishing [date should be read as "published 1780s"]
artworks.description: The image shows intersecting lines and geometric shapes forming arches and bridges. The curving lines, arches, ropes, and pulleys create an abstract architectural scene. Figures appear small against the structures, suggesting workers or travelers. The detailed strokes and play of light and shadow enhance the grandeur of the architecture.

artworks.title: The Smoking Fire
artworks.medium: etching, engraving, sulphur tint or open bite, burnishing
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an interior space with arches, staircases, and towering architectural elements. The scene includes grand, arched structures that overlap and intertwine with intricate railings and columns. The composition shows architectural details like ropes, chains, and large pieces of machinery or scaffolding within the arches. A complex array of lines and shades create deep contrast in the space. Light filters through high arched windows, illuminating the stonework with shadows and light.

artworks.title: The Giant Wheel
artworks.medium: etching, engraving [date should be read as "published 1780s"]
artworks.description: The image displays intersecting lines and geometric shapes forming an abstract composition. There are massive stone blocks, a skeletal framework, crisscrossing beams, arches, overgrown vegetation, and small figures on the rocks.

artworks.title: Prisoners on a Projecting Platform
artworks.medium: etching, engraving, sulphur tint or open bite, burnishing
artworks.description: The image features a web of lines and arches creating geometric shapes. Beams and chains hang from the ceilings while multiple levels and platforms intertwine. The overpasses and stone-like textures enhance the sense of an architectural structure.

artworks.title: The Arch with a Shell Ornament
artworks.medium: etching, engraving, sulphur tint or open bite, drypoint
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an intricate and architectural fantasy interior. The composition displays a surreal setting filled with an elaborate network of staircases, arches, and beams that interconnect in a labyrinthine manner. Massive stone arches and vaults dominate the space. The dim lighting casts dramatic shadows. Various architectural elements, like ropes and ladders, contribute to the complexity of the scene.

artworks.title: The Sawhorse
artworks.medium: etching, engraving, sulphur tint or open bite, scratching [date should be read as "published 1780s"]
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an architectural space filled with arches and staircases. The image depicts a grand and complex interior. The scene features multiple arches and staircases leading in different directions, creating a maze-like atmosphere. Light and shadow add depth to the structure, and detailed textures emphasize the stone materials. The composition conveys a sense of mystery and grandeur, with intricate details capturing attention to the scale and masonry work.

artworks.title: The Gothic Arch
artworks.medium: etching, engraving, sulphur tint or open bite, burnishing
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an interior with intricate architectural elements such as staircases and arches. The image showcases a complex network of arches, stairways, balustrades, and various architectural features. Cross-hatching creates contrast between light and shadow for depth. The structure appears massive, filled with intricate details that suggest an unfathomable scale. The drawing captures an atmosphere of mystery and intricacy, leading the viewer through a maze of corridors and pathways.

artworks.title: The Pier with a Lamp
artworks.medium: etching, engraving, sulphur tint or open bite, burnishing [date should be read as "published 1780s"]

artworks.title: River with Town
artworks.artist: Cornelis Ploos van Amstel (editor) and Bernhard Schreuder (printmaker), after Pieter Coopse
artworks.medium: etching printed in black ink on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet: 11 × 22 cm (4 5/16 × 8 11/16 in.) cut within platemark
artworks.description: The image shows a serene scene with a low viewpoint overlooking a water body. There are boats and buildings in the distance, possibly a town with a church. The water reflects these forms. A small boat with a figure is on the right, while two larger sailboats with visible masts are on the left, with slightly opened sails. The artwork features thin, precise lines and lacks vibrant colors, creating a minimalist and monochromatic look that highlights the peaceful atmosphere. The palette consists of natural paper tones and dark ink lines.
